title: Analista Pleno de Parcerias Institucionais
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista Pleno de Parcerias Institucionais em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Jusfy está em busca de uma pessoa Analista Pleno de Parcerias Institucionais. Somos uma legaltech em crescimento acelerado - desenvolvemos tecnologia, IA e ferramentas de produtividade para advogados e departamentos jurídicos do Brasil.

Nesta posição, você será responsável pela gestão operacional das parcerias estratégicas da Jusfy, atuando diretamente com entidades como a Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil, universidades e associações. Você vai garantir que essas parcerias aconteçam de ponta a ponta - da estruturação ao acompanhamento - assegurando execução, relacionamento e resultado.

Você terá uma atuação organizada e analítica, conduzindo o onboarding de novos parceiros, mantendo o relacionamento institucional no dia a dia e atuando como ponte entre Parcerias e as áreas internas para garantir que cada iniciativa saia do papel.

Esta é uma posição para pessoas com perfil mão na massa, forte senso de organização e facilidade de relacionamento com stakeholders institucionais, que gostam de estruturar processos e sustentar operações que crescem.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Apoiar operacionalmente a prospecção de novos parceiros institucionais, organizando pipeline, agendas, materiais e follow-ups de negociação.
  • Apoiar a formalização e documentação das parcerias, estruturando contrapartidas acordadas com cada parceiro.
  • Conduzir o onboarding operacional de parceiros, organizando kick-offs, cronogramas e planos de ação.
  • Mapear canais e oportunidades de divulgação e estruturar os fluxos de comunicação com parceiros.
  • Fazer o acompanhamento operacional das parcerias ativas, garantindo a execução das entregas acordadas.
  • Manter relacionamento recorrente com stakeholders institucionais e acompanhar indicadores e resultados.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e expansão das parcerias.
  • Atuar como ponte entre Parcerias, Marketing, Produto e Operações, garantindo alinhamento entre as áreas.
  • Apoiar a construção de materiais e apresentações institucionais.
  • Estruturar e manter controles, relatórios, indicadores e playbooks operacionais, garantindo previsibilidade à área.


O que buscamos:

  • Perfil organizado, executor e analítico, com forte senso de acompanhamento.
  • Boa comunicação institucional, verbal e escrita.
  • Capacidade de gerir múltiplas demandas simultaneamente.
  • Facilidade de relacionamento com stakeholders.
  • Experiência com organização de projetos e processos.
  • Excel ou Google Sheets intermediário.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com parcerias institucionais ou relações institucionais.
  • Experiência com entidades, associações ou universidades.
  • Experiência em startups, SaaS ou tecnologia - preferencialmente legaltech.
  • Familiaridade com CRM e ferramentas de gestão.
  • Experiência com eventos ou ações institucionais.


PJ | Remoto


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível no valor de R$ 265,00
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados)
  • Day Off de aniversário
  • Descanso remunerado
  • Ambiente descontraído e inovador
  • Oportunidade de atuar em projetos com impacto real no crescimento da empresa


Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Quer fazer parte de uma das legaltechs que mais cresce no Brasil? Se candidate na posição.

title: Senior Procurement Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Procurement Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Position Overview

This is not a traditional purchasing role.

We are looking for a procurement leader capable of building strategic relationships with manufacturers, distributors, fabricators, and suppliers across the building envelope industry.

The ideal candidate understands construction procurement, supply chain management, sourcing strategies, and supplier negotiations within industries such as:

  • Architectural Glass & Glazing
  • Curtain Wall Systems
  • Metal Fabrication
  • ACM & Metal Panel Systems
  • Building Envelope Products
  • Insulation Systems
  • Waterproofing & Air Barrier Systems
  • Fasteners & Specialty Construction Products

This individual will play a direct role in improving project profitability, strengthening supplier partnerships, and creating scalable procurement processes to support Longarone's next phase of growth.



Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and execute Longarone's procurement strategy.
  • Negotiate national and international supplier agreements.
  • Establish long-term strategic partnerships with manufacturers and distributors.
  • Lead sourcing initiatives focused on cost reduction and supply chain optimization.
  • Collaborate with Estimators and Project Managers during budgeting and project planning.
  • Evaluate new suppliers, products, technologies, and market opportunities.
  • Monitor commodity pricing trends and market fluctuations.
  • Manage procurement forecasting and material planning.
  • Improve procurement systems, reporting, and purchasing controls.
  • Coordinate material purchasing, logistics, and delivery schedules.
  • Present monthly procurement performance reports to executive leadership.



Desired BackgroundRequired
  • 7+ years of procurement, purchasing, sourcing, or supply chain experience.
  • Experience within construction, glazing, architectural glass, façade systems, building envelope, metal fabrication, or related industries.
  • Strong contract negotiation and supplier management experience.
  • Proven track record of generating measurable cost savings.
  • Ability to analyze pricing structures and supplier performance.
  • Fluent English communication skills.


Highly Preferred
  • Existing relationships with manufacturers and distributors in the façade, glazing, curtain wall, or architectural metals sectors.
  • Experience purchasing materials for commercial construction projects.
  • Knowledge of Passive House, high-performance building systems, and modern façade technologies.
  • Experience with ERP and procurement management software.


Success Metrics
  • Procurement Savings
  • Cost Avoidance
  • Supplier Reliability
  • Lead Time Reduction
  • Margin Improvement
  • Forecast Accuracy
  • Supply Chain Stability


Compensation

Competitive Base Salary + Performance Bonus

The selected candidate will participate in a Procurement Savings Incentive Program tied directly to measurable value creation through:

  • Supplier negotiations
  • Strategic sourcing
  • Cost reductions
  • Supply chain improvements
  • Margin enhancement initiatives

Top performers will have significant earning potential tied to their impact on company profitability.



Why Join Longarone?
  • Fully Remote Position
  • Direct Access to Executive Leadership
  • High Growth Environment
  • Opportunity to Build a World-Class Procurement Department
  • Performance-Based Compensation
  • Work on Landmark Building Envelope Projects Throughout the Northeast U.S.

title: Chef Corporativo Parceiro
description:

A Unox , líder global na produção de fornos de alta qualidade e orgulhosamente certificada como Great Place to Work® no Brasil, está procurando Chefs Corporativos para se juntar à nossa equipe de parceiros nacionais.


Nessa função, você será responsável por demonstrar, treinar e orientar clientes e parceiros sobre o uso eficiente das tecnologias da Unox , promovendo soluções inovadoras que otimizem processos e elevem a qualidade e rentabilidade das operações culinárias.


Atividades:

  • Conduzir treinamentos práticos e técnicos para equipes de cozinha;
  • Desenvolver receitas que demonstrem a versatilidade dos equipamentos;
  • Realizar demonstrações para clientes, eventos e feiras do setor;
  • Apoiar a equipe comercial com insights técnicos e argumentos estratégicos;
  • Acompanhar tendências gastronômicas e propor soluções inovadoras;
  • Oferecer suporte pós-venda para garantir performance máxima dos produtos UNOX.


Requisitos:

  • Formação técnica ou experiência prévia em Gastronomia e áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em fornos combinados e diferentes técnicas de cocção;
  • CNH (B) ativa e disponibilidade para viagens e deslocamentos;
  • Boa comunicação interpessoal e habilidades de apresentação;
  • Proatividade e perfil mão na massa;
  • Desejável: Inglês Intermediário.


Informações Adicionais:

  • Atuação como embaixador da marca;
  • Atuação PRESENCIAL sob demanda;
  • Fornecemos treinamento presencial e remoto sobre nossa tecnologia e equipamentos;
  • Contratação PJ.



Por que Unox?

Inovação contínua : A Unox está na vanguarda da tecnologia e inovação, trabalhando em projetos pioneiros e desafiadores.


Ambiente de trabalho : Fomos certificados pelo Great Place To Work Institute como uma das 100 melhores empresas da Europa. Nosso ambiente de trabalho jovem e positivo promove a colaboração e valoriza as ideias de todos os nossos funcionários. Organizamos regularmente eventos da empresa para networking e formação de equipes com colegas.


Crescimento Profissional : A Unox investe no desenvolvimento de seus colaboradores por meio de programas de treinamento contínuo, coaching individual e oportunidades de carreira, garantindo constante crescimento pessoal e profissional.


O posto de trabalho está aberto a candidatos de todos os gêneros e identidades de gênero, em conformidade com os regulamentos atuais de igualdade de oportunidades.

title: Cloud program Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud program Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Title: Cloud Program Manager

Location: 100% Remote

Buscamos profissional para atuar no suporte de primeiro nível (N1) às aplicações de Front Office de uma grande instituição financeira, com foco em Mercado de Capitais / Renda Fixa .   • Inglês avançado para atender clientes internacionais

Diferenciais

title: Junior Writer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Junior Writer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junior Writer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM

About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.


Role Overview

As a Junior Writer, you will be responsible for adapting and localizing English content into portuguese - culturally relevant versions, ensuring narrative consistency, emotional depth, and audience engagement. You will work closely with editorial, production, and AI teams to refine scripts, monitor performance, and enhance content quality across the platform.


Key Responsibilities

1. Content Development & Adaptation

  • Review English show materials (audio/scripts) and prepare localization sheets and concept notes with strong cultural adaptation.
  • Adapt scripts using designated GenAI tools, ensuring proper structuring, tone, and inclusion of emotion tags where required.
  • Review and refine AI-generated translations to ensure alignment with editorial standards, cultural nuances, and narrative integrity.
  • Incorporate editorial and technical feedback to revise and deliver high-quality, polished scripts.
  • Deliver ~300 localized and AI-adapted scripts per month, adhering to timelines and quality benchmarks.


2. Quality Reviews & Continuous Improvement

  • Review published audio episodes and provide structured feedback on AI-generated adaptations.
  • Identify recurring issues in translation, tone, or storytelling and recommend improvements.
  • Analyze user comments and feedback to enhance content quality and relevance.


3. Production Support & Quality Assurance

  • Suggest suitable voice-over artists based on character and project requirements
  • Ensure produced content aligns with creative intent and quality standards
  • Conduct quality checks on production samples and provide actionable feedback to ensure “first-time-right” output.


4. Promotion Support

  • Develop concepts and draft scripts for promotional content (10–60 minutes) aligned with series positioning and storytelling goals


5. AI-Driven Editorial Innovation & Tool Adoption

  • Demonstrate hands-on usage of AI tools to enhance editorial workflows, script development, research, adaptation, and content optimization.
  • Apply strong editorial judgment while leveraging GenAI tools to ensure narrative quality, factual consistency, cultural sensitivity, and platform standards.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or related
  • Strong storytelling skills with an understanding of narrative structure, character development, and pacing.
  • Familiarity with AI-based writing or content adaptation tools is preferred
  • Experience in content localization, translation review, or scriptwriting is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain consistency across high-volume deliverables.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret user data and feedback.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced content production environment.

title: Senior Visual Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Visual Designer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Our culture isn’t something people join, it’s something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a fit, we say go for it. Let’s build something great together.



We're looking for a Visual (Design Systems) Designer with exceptional visual design skills to support a large-scale Design System initiative for a leading enterprise software platform. This role is focused on visual exploration, design systems thinking, and crafting polished user interface experiences that can scale across complex products


You'll work closely with an established Design System team to help define and evolve the visual language of the platform. This is a highly collaborative role where you'll explore design directions, create high-fidelity concepts, evaluate design solutions, and help bridge brand expression with scalable system design.


Must Haves

  • 5+ years of experience in UX/UI, Product Design, or Visual Design roles with a strong emphasis on user interface design and visual craft.
  • Outstanding visual design portfolio demonstrating excellence in typography, color systems, spacing, hierarchy, layout, iconography, and interaction design.
  • Experience working within or contributing to design systems, with an understanding of how visual decisions scale across products and experiences.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise software, complex workflows, information-dense interfaces, and interaction patterns.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.1 AA, and experience incorporating accessibility considerations into visual design decisions
  • Comfort working in ambiguous environments, synthesizing inputs, forming design recommendations, and defending design rationale with stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with designers, product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Experience working on enterprise SaaS products.
  • Previous involvement in Design System initiatives or component library evolution.
  • Experience conducting competitive visual analysis and translating insights into design recommendations.
  • Familiarity with Material UI (MUI) or other enterprise design system frameworks.



Key Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with the Design System team to explore and define future visual directions for enterprise software products.
  • Explore, iterate, and refine visual design directions across areas such as color, typography, spacing, elevation, iconography, and overall product aesthetics.
  • Create high-fidelity design concepts and prototypes that demonstrate how visual design decisions apply across real product workflows and use cases.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable visual patterns that can be incorporated into the broader Design System.
  • Support design evaluation activities by preparing assets, prototypes, and presentation materials for stakeholder reviews and user feedback sessions.
  • Collaborate with product designers, researchers, engineers, and brand partners to align visual design direction with user needs and business goals.
  • Help translate brand principles into practical, scalable Design System solutions that can be adopted across products,
  • Advocate for accessibility, consistency, and usability throughout the design process.
  • Contribute to a culture of design excellence through collaboration, critique, and thoughtful design discussion.

title: Global Talent & Leadership Development Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global Talent & Leadership Development Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us


Pyxus / Alliance One International, headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina, USA is a leading global supplier of tobacco leaf. With operations in approximately 30 countries, we deliver high-quality, value-added products and services to customers in over 90 countries. As a trusted partner in the industry, we prioritize responsible sourcing, sustainability, and traceability. Our commitment to ethical practices and environmental stewardship is a cornerstone of our operations worldwide.


Key Responsibilities

  • Talent Reviews & Succession Planning

Collaborates in the design and implementation of the global Talent Management framework to ensure a strong and consistent leadership pipeline across the organization. Aligns Oracle systems with business needs and drives global adoption of talent practices. Facilitates annual Talent Reviews and calibration sessions, partners with Regional HR to identify critical roles, and develops succession plans for M4+ leadership positions. Monitors development progress and provides talent insights and metrics to support workforce planning and strategic decisions.

  • Learning & Development

Leads the global Learning & Development strategy aligned with business priorities and capability needs. Works closely with HR and business leaders to define learning priorities and deliver leadership, management, and professional development programs. Oversees LinkedIn Learning and Oracle Learning platforms, including governance, campaigns, user experience, and vendor management. Tracks participation, engagement, and career outcomes, using data, KPIs, and ROI analysis to continuously improve learning effectiveness.

  • Pyxus Academy Rotational Program

Leads the design, governance, and execution of the rotational program, partnering with business leaders and HR to identify opportunities and participants. Coordinates selection, development plans, and stakeholder alignment, while monitoring progress and outcomes to strengthen the internal talent pipeline through hands-on and cross-functional experiences.

  • Reporting & KPIs

Develops and tracks metrics to measure the efficiency and impact of talent and learning initiatives, using data-driven insights to improve processes.

  • Budget & Resource Management

Monitors budget adherence and manages contracts with external vendors to ensure effective and strategic use of resources.


Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Fluent English
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, HR or related field required
  • Relevant business operations and Human Resources experience
  • Experience in deploying Talent Reviews & Succession Planning, Learning and Development programs and rotational development initiatives
  • Strong change agility and proven ability to deal with ambiguity
  • Leadership experience or comparable leadership responsibility
  • Influencing diverse teams in a global organization without formal leadership
  • Strategic orientation and critical thinking skills with the ability to align and integrate HR programs toward a holistic global approach to localization and business applicability
  • Demonstrated success in driving and successfully completing HR projects and process improvements in a global workplace
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and collaborative skills across levels, with an ability to persuade and influence, and the ability to build enthusiasm and commitment
  • Highly flexible, agile, collaborative, and effective at leading and delivering business imperatives in a dynamic environment
  • Business acumen paired with a hands-on mentality and the ability to match business needs with HR deliverables
  • Analytical and data-driven, with the ability to integrate complex data into insights to create future-focused, high-impact people business strategies
  • Work experience in multiple HR roles and organizations (COE, HRBP, SS)
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressured, ambiguous work environment, paying close attention to detail and meeting business-driven deadlines
  • Demonstrated organizational skills and ability to coordinate multiple activities and shift priorities meeting established deadlines
  • Demonstrated ability to break down problems into manageable tasks and processes while challenging assumptions
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with extreme professionalism and discretion

Profit-Sharing Program (PPR)

Health Insurance Plans

50% Medication Allowance

Education and foreign language allowance

Mobile Phone Plan

Private Pension Plan

Meal Card

Corporate Time Off Days

Wellhub

Group Life Insurance

title: Global Talent & Leadership Development Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global Talent & Leadership Development Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us


Pyxus / Alliance One International, headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina, USA is a leading global supplier of tobacco leaf. With operations in approximately 30 countries, we deliver high-quality, value-added products and services to customers in over 90 countries. As a trusted partner in the industry, we prioritize responsible sourcing, sustainability, and traceability. Our commitment to ethical practices and environmental stewardship is a cornerstone of our operations worldwide.


Key Responsibilities

  • Talent Reviews & Succession Planning

Collaborates in the design and implementation of the global Talent Management framework to ensure a strong and consistent leadership pipeline across the organization. Aligns Oracle systems with business needs and drives global adoption of talent practices. Facilitates annual Talent Reviews and calibration sessions, partners with Regional HR to identify critical roles, and develops succession plans for M4+ leadership positions. Monitors development progress and provides talent insights and metrics to support workforce planning and strategic decisions.

  • Learning & Development

Leads the global Learning & Development strategy aligned with business priorities and capability needs. Works closely with HR and business leaders to define learning priorities and deliver leadership, management, and professional development programs. Oversees LinkedIn Learning and Oracle Learning platforms, including governance, campaigns, user experience, and vendor management. Tracks participation, engagement, and career outcomes, using data, KPIs, and ROI analysis to continuously improve learning effectiveness.

Leads the design, governance, and execution of the rotational program, partnering with business leaders and HR to identify opportunities and participants. Coordinates selection, development plans, and stakeholder alignment, while monitoring progress and outcomes to strengthen the internal talent pipeline through hands-on and cross-functional experiences.

  • Reporting & KPIs

Develops and tracks metrics to measure the efficiency and impact of talent and learning initiatives, using data-driven insights to improve processes.

  • Budget & Resource Management

Monitors budget adherence and manages contracts with external vendors to ensure effective and strategic use of resources.


Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Fluent English
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, HR or related field required
  • Relevant business operations and Human Resources experience
  • Experience in deploying Talent Reviews & Succession Planning, Learning and Development programs and rotational development initiatives
  • Strong change agility and proven ability to deal with ambiguity
  • Leadership experience or comparable leadership responsibility

title: Junior Writer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Junior Writer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junior Writer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM

About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.


Role Overview

As a Junior Writer, you will be responsible for adapting and localizing English content into portuguese - culturally relevant versions, ensuring narrative consistency, emotional depth, and audience engagement. You will work closely with editorial, production, and AI teams to refine scripts, monitor performance, and enhance content quality across the platform.


Key Responsibilities

1. Content Development & Adaptation

  • Review English show materials (audio/scripts) and prepare localization sheets and concept notes with strong cultural adaptation.
  • Adapt scripts using designated GenAI tools, ensuring proper structuring, tone, and inclusion of emotion tags where required.
  • Review and refine AI-generated translations to ensure alignment with editorial standards, cultural nuances, and narrative integrity.
  • Incorporate editorial and technical feedback to revise and deliver high-quality, polished scripts.
  • Deliver ~300 localized and AI-adapted scripts per month, adhering to timelines and quality benchmarks.


2. Quality Reviews & Continuous Improvement

  • Review published audio episodes and provide structured feedback on AI-generated adaptations.
  • Identify recurring issues in translation, tone, or storytelling and recommend improvements.
  • Analyze user comments and feedback to enhance content quality and relevance.


3. Production Support & Quality Assurance

  • Suggest suitable voice-over artists based on character and project requirements
  • Ensure produced content aligns with creative intent and quality standards
  • Conduct quality checks on production samples and provide actionable feedback to ensure “first-time-right” output.


4. Promotion Support

  • Develop concepts and draft scripts for promotional content (10–60 minutes) aligned with series positioning and storytelling goals


5. AI-Driven Editorial Innovation & Tool Adoption

  • Demonstrate hands-on usage of AI tools to enhance editorial workflows, script development, research, adaptation, and content optimization.
  • Apply strong editorial judgment while leveraging GenAI tools to ensure narrative quality, factual consistency, cultural sensitivity, and platform standards.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or related
  • Strong storytelling skills with an understanding of narrative structure, character development, and pacing.
  • Familiarity with AI-based writing or content adaptation tools is preferred
  • Experience in content localization, translation review, or scriptwriting is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain consistency across high-volume deliverables.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret user data and feedback.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced content production environment.

You'll work closely with an established Design System team to help define and evolve the visual language of the platform. Must Haves

  • Familiarity with accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.1 AA, and experience incorporating accessibility considerations into visual design decisions
  • Comfort working in ambiguous environments, synthesizing inputs, forming design recommendations, and defending design rationale with stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • Experience working on enterprise SaaS products.
  • Previous involvement in Design System initiatives or component library evolution.
  • Experience conducting competitive visual analysis and translating insights into design recommendations.
  • Familiarity with Material UI (MUI) or other enterprise design system frameworks.



Key Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with the Design System team to explore and define future visual directions for enterprise software products.
  • Explore, iterate, and refine visual design directions across areas such as color, typography, spacing, elevation, iconography, and overall product aesthetics.
  • Create high-fidelity design concepts and prototypes that demonstrate how visual design decisions apply across real product workflows and use cases.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable visual patterns that can be incorporated into the broader Design System.
  • Support design evaluation activities by preparing assets, prototypes, and presentation materials for stakeholder reviews and user feedback sessions.
  • Collaborate with product designers, researchers, engineers, and brand partners to align visual design direction with user needs and business goals.
  • Help translate brand principles into practical, scalable Design System solutions that can be adopted across products,
  • Advocate for accessibility, consistency, and usability throughout the design process.
  • Contribute to a culture of design excellence through collaboration, critique, and thoughtful design discussion.

title: Head of Compliance, Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Compliance, Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Head of Compliance & MLRO to oversee the company's compliance and regulatory responsibilities in Brazil. This role will support the business in maintaining a strong compliance culture, managing regulatory relationships, and ensuring alignment with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.


Working closely with local and regional stakeholders, the successful candidate will provide practical compliance guidance while supporting the company's growth and licensing initiatives in Brazil.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated MLRO and lead compliance representative for the Brazil business.
  • Oversee the company's compliance, AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial crime programs.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and provide guidance on relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain relationships with regulators and support regulatory enquiries, reviews, and examinations.
  • Support licensing, registration, and other regulatory initiatives as required.
  • Provide compliance advice to business and operational teams on new products, services, and business activities.
  • Help ensure policies, procedures, and controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory expectations.
  • Oversee key compliance processes, including customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Identify compliance risks and work with stakeholders to implement appropriate controls and solutions.
  • Prepare compliance updates and reporting for management.
  • Deliver compliance training and promote a strong culture of compliance across the organization.
  • Collaborate with regional and global teams on compliance-related matters.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets.
  • Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred.
  • Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous.
  • Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial.
  • Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment.
  • Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.


OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

description:

We are looking for a full-time, remote Project Manager with 5+ years of experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives within software and technology organizations. This role is focused on driving multiple concurrent product transition, migration, and implementation projects while coordinating stakeholders across Product, Engineering, IT, Legal, Finance, Operations, and Implementation teams.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments, excels at managing competing priorities, and can serve as the central point of coordination across numerous workstreams. You will act as the organizational \"control tower,\" ensuring critical initiatives stay on track, dependencies are identified early, risks are mitigated, and teams remain aligned toward shared objectives.

Our client is a leading energy technology company focused on digitizing fuel operations through a single, real-time platform. Their software connects people, equipment, and facilities to provide enterprise-wide visibility and data-driven insights that fuel asset optimization, improve operational efficiency, and help organizations manage risk, maintenance, and fuel logistics more effectively.


Responsibilities

  • Serve as the central coordinator for 15 concurrent projects, including product transitions, implementation initiatives, and product enhancements
  • Drive cross-functional programs involving Product, Engineering, IT, Legal, Finance, Operations, Training, and Implementation teams
  • Develop and maintain program-level roadmaps, timelines, and dependency tracking
  • Ensure legacy product retirement initiatives remain on schedule and aligned with business objectives
  • Coordinate customer transition activities, including internal readiness, legal requirements, implementation planning, and operational processes
  • Partner with IT and Engineering teams to ensure systems, infrastructure, and technical requirements are properly aligned
  • Work closely with Legal and Operations teams to support product migrations, compliance requirements, notifications, and transition planning
  • Track and manage action items across multiple stakeholders and departments
  • Facilitate prioritization discussions and ensure resources remain focused on the highest-impact initiatives
  • Proactively identify project risks and drive resolution before they impact delivery timelines
  • Provide executive-level visibility into program status, blockers, dependencies, and milestones
  • Support implementation and rollout planning to ensure successful adoption of new products and services
  • Collaborate with Scrum Masters, Product Managers, and Engineering teams while maintaining a broader program-level perspective
  • Establish and improve processes for managing large-scale, cross-functional initiatives
  • Drive accountability across teams and ensure commitments are completed on schedule


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in Program Management, Technical Program Management, Project Management, or Product Operations roles
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects in software or technology-focused organizations
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience coordinating work across multiple business functions and departments
  • Ability to identify gaps, dependencies, risks, and process improvements across complex initiatives
  • Strong experience facilitating cross-functional collaboration and driving execution
  • Experience working with software development, product management, and engineering organizations
  • Technical acumen with a solid understanding of software development, infrastructure, and technology concepts
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities
  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and maintain accountability across teams
  • Experience operating in fast-paced environments with competing priorities and evolving requirements


Preferred Experience

  • Experience managing product migrations, software implementations, or legacy system retirement programs
  • Experience using Kanban-based project management methodologies
  • Experience working with Product, Engineering, IT, Legal, Finance, and Operations teams
  • Background in SaaS, enterprise software, or technology-driven organizations
  • Experience with portfolio management, program governance, or PMO functions
  • Familiarity with Agile development environments
  • Experience using project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms
  • Experience supporting organizational change management initiatives
  • Experience working in highly cross-functional, matrixed environments


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions. Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Transmission Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Transmission Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Transmission Line Engineer - LATAM


Our client is seeking a Transmission Line Engineer to join their growing engineering team. This role will be responsible for supporting the analysis, design, and execution of overhead transmission line projects for utility and energy clients.


The ideal candidate will have experience in transmission line design, power systems, and engineering project delivery, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.


This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and contributing to the successful delivery of critical power infrastructure projects.


Key Responsibilities

  • Perform and coordinate transmission line engineering activities for new and existing overhead transmission projects.
  • Complete engineering analysis, calculations, and design work associated with transmission line systems.
  • Provide technical support to internal stakeholders, customers, and project teams.
  • Review project requirements and specifications and recommend design improvements when necessary.
  • Solve complex engineering challenges related to transmission line design and construction.
  • Prepare technical reports, analyses, calculations, and presentations.
  • Perform and oversee transmission line calculations, including:
  • Sag-tension analysis
  • Wire blowout calculations
  • Swing angle analysis
  • Damper recommendations
  • Conductor and wire selection
  • Support multiple projects simultaneously while meeting project schedules and deadlines.
  • Collaborate with engineering, sales, and project management teams to ensure successful project execution.
  • Travel occasionally to customer sites to support project meetings, technical presentations, and project development activities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, preferably with an emphasis in Power Systems.
  • Experience working on utility, transmission, or power infrastructure projects.
  • Familiarity with transmission line design software such as:
  • PLS-CADD
  • SAG10
  • ETAP
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team environment.


What We're Looking For

  • Self-motivated and results-driven professional.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to quality and accuracy.
  • Customer-focused mindset with excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Continuous learner with a passion for professional growth and development.
  • Team player who thrives in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.


Apply Today

If you are passionate about power systems, transmission engineering, and delivering innovative solutions for critical infrastructure projects, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior Visual Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Visual Designer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Our culture isn’t something people join, it’s something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a fit, we say go for it. Let’s build something great together.



We're looking for a Visual (Design Systems) Designer with exceptional visual design skills to support a large-scale Design System initiative for a leading enterprise software platform. This role is focused on visual exploration, design systems thinking, and crafting polished user interface experiences that can scale across complex products


You'll work closely with an established Design System team to help define and evolve the visual language of the platform. This is a highly collaborative role where you'll explore design directions, create high-fidelity concepts, evaluate design solutions, and help bridge brand expression with scalable system design.


Must Haves

  • 5+ years of experience in UX/UI, Product Design, or Visual Design roles with a strong emphasis on user interface design and visual craft.
  • Outstanding visual design portfolio demonstrating excellence in typography, color systems, spacing, hierarchy, layout, iconography, and interaction design.
  • Experience working within or contributing to design systems, with an understanding of how visual decisions scale across products and experiences.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise software, complex workflows, information-dense interfaces, and interaction patterns.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.1 AA, and experience incorporating accessibility considerations into visual design decisions
  • Comfort working in ambiguous environments, synthesizing inputs, forming design recommendations, and defending design rationale with stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with designers, product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Experience working on enterprise SaaS products.
  • Previous involvement in Design System initiatives or component library evolution.
  • Experience conducting competitive visual analysis and translating insights into design recommendations.
  • Familiarity with Material UI (MUI) or other enterprise design system frameworks.



Key Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with the Design System team to explore and define future visual directions for enterprise software products.
  • Explore, iterate, and refine visual design directions across areas such as color, typography, spacing, elevation, iconography, and overall product aesthetics.
  • Create high-fidelity design concepts and prototypes that demonstrate how visual design decisions apply across real product workflows and use cases.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable visual patterns that can be incorporated into the broader Design System.
  • Support design evaluation activities by preparing assets, prototypes, and presentation materials for stakeholder reviews and user feedback sessions.
  • Collaborate with product designers, researchers, engineers, and brand partners to align visual design direction with user needs and business goals.
  • Help translate brand principles into practical, scalable Design System solutions that can be adopted across products,
  • Advocate for accessibility, consistency, and usability throughout the design process.
  • Contribute to a culture of design excellence through collaboration, critique, and thoughtful design discussion.

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Junior Writer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Junior Writer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junior Writer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM

About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.


Role Overview

As a Junior Writer, you will be responsible for adapting and localizing English content into portuguese - culturally relevant versions, ensuring narrative consistency, emotional depth, and audience engagement. You will work closely with editorial, production, and AI teams to refine scripts, monitor performance, and enhance content quality across the platform.


Key Responsibilities

1. Content Development & Adaptation

  • Review English show materials (audio/scripts) and prepare localization sheets and concept notes with strong cultural adaptation.
  • Adapt scripts using designated GenAI tools, ensuring proper structuring, tone, and inclusion of emotion tags where required.
  • Review and refine AI-generated translations to ensure alignment with editorial standards, cultural nuances, and narrative integrity.
  • Incorporate editorial and technical feedback to revise and deliver high-quality, polished scripts.
  • Deliver ~300 localized and AI-adapted scripts per month, adhering to timelines and quality benchmarks.


2. Quality Reviews & Continuous Improvement

  • Review published audio episodes and provide structured feedback on AI-generated adaptations.
  • Identify recurring issues in translation, tone, or storytelling and recommend improvements.
  • Analyze user comments and feedback to enhance content quality and relevance.


3. Production Support & Quality Assurance

  • Suggest suitable voice-over artists based on character and project requirements
  • Ensure produced content aligns with creative intent and quality standards
  • Conduct quality checks on production samples and provide actionable feedback to ensure “first-time-right” output.


4. Promotion Support

  • Develop concepts and draft scripts for promotional content (10–60 minutes) aligned with series positioning and storytelling goals


5. AI-Driven Editorial Innovation & Tool Adoption

  • Demonstrate hands-on usage of AI tools to enhance editorial workflows, script development, research, adaptation, and content optimization.
  • Apply strong editorial judgment while leveraging GenAI tools to ensure narrative quality, factual consistency, cultural sensitivity, and platform standards.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or related
  • Strong storytelling skills with an understanding of narrative structure, character development, and pacing.
  • Familiarity with AI-based writing or content adaptation tools is preferred
  • Experience in content localization, translation review, or scriptwriting is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain consistency across high-volume deliverables.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret user data and feedback.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced content production environment.

title: Head of Compliance, Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Compliance, Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Head of Compliance & MLRO to oversee the company's compliance and regulatory responsibilities in Brazil. This role will support the business in maintaining a strong compliance culture, managing regulatory relationships, and ensuring alignment with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.


Working closely with local and regional stakeholders, the successful candidate will provide practical compliance guidance while supporting the company's growth and licensing initiatives in Brazil.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated MLRO and lead compliance representative for the Brazil business.
  • Oversee the company's compliance, AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial crime programs.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and provide guidance on relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain relationships with regulators and support regulatory enquiries, reviews, and examinations.
  • Support licensing, registration, and other regulatory initiatives as required.
  • Provide compliance advice to business and operational teams on new products, services, and business activities.
  • Help ensure policies, procedures, and controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory expectations.
  • Oversee key compliance processes, including customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Identify compliance risks and work with stakeholders to implement appropriate controls and solutions.
  • Prepare compliance updates and reporting for management.
  • Deliver compliance training and promote a strong culture of compliance across the organization.
  • Collaborate with regional and global teams on compliance-related matters.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets.
  • Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred.
  • Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous.
  • Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial.
  • Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment.
  • Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.


OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Visual Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Visual Designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Our culture isn’t something people join, it’s something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a fit, we say go for it. Let’s build something great together.



We're looking for a Visual (Design Systems) Designer with exceptional visual design skills to support a large-scale Design System initiative for a leading enterprise software platform. This role is focused on visual exploration, design systems thinking, and crafting polished user interface experiences that can scale across complex products


You'll work closely with an established Design System team to help define and evolve the visual language of the platform. This is a highly collaborative role where you'll explore design directions, create high-fidelity concepts, evaluate design solutions, and help bridge brand expression with scalable system design.


Must Haves

  • 5+ years of experience in UX/UI, Product Design, or Visual Design roles with a strong emphasis on user interface design and visual craft.
  • Outstanding visual design portfolio demonstrating excellence in typography, color systems, spacing, hierarchy, layout, iconography, and interaction design.
  • Experience working within or contributing to design systems, with an understanding of how visual decisions scale across products and experiences.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise software, complex workflows, information-dense interfaces, and interaction patterns.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.1 AA, and experience incorporating accessibility considerations into visual design decisions
  • Comfort working in ambiguous environments, synthesizing inputs, forming design recommendations, and defending design rationale with stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with designers, product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Experience working on enterprise SaaS products.
  • Previous involvement in Design System initiatives or component library evolution.
  • Experience conducting competitive visual analysis and translating insights into design recommendations.
  • Familiarity with Material UI (MUI) or other enterprise design system frameworks.



Key Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with the Design System team to explore and define future visual directions for enterprise software products.
  • Explore, iterate, and refine visual design directions across areas such as color, typography, spacing, elevation, iconography, and overall product aesthetics.
  • Create high-fidelity design concepts and prototypes that demonstrate how visual design decisions apply across real product workflows and use cases.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable visual patterns that can be incorporated into the broader Design System.
  • Support design evaluation activities by preparing assets, prototypes, and presentation materials for stakeholder reviews and user feedback sessions.
  • Collaborate with product designers, researchers, engineers, and brand partners to align visual design direction with user needs and business goals.
  • Help translate brand principles into practical, scalable Design System solutions that can be adopted across products,
  • Advocate for accessibility, consistency, and usability throughout the design process.
  • Contribute to a culture of design excellence through collaboration, critique, and thoughtful design discussion.

title: Global Performance and Employee Experience Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global Performance and Employee Experience Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us


Pyxus / Alliance One International, headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina, USA is a leading global supplier of tobacco leaf. With operations in approximately 30 countries, we deliver high-quality, value-added products and services to customers in over 90 countries. As a trusted partner in the industry, we prioritize responsible sourcing, sustainability, and traceability. Our commitment to ethical practices and environmental stewardship is a cornerstone of our operations worldwide.


Key Responsibilities

  • Talent Acquisition & Employer Branding

Oversees global Talent Acquisition policies, processes, and systems within Oracle, ensuring effective and consistent recruitment practices worldwide. Manages external vendors such as LinkedIn Recruiter and job platforms, as well as system access and governance. Leads the Employer Value Proposition (EVP) and employer branding strategy, working closely with Corporate Communications to strengthen brand awareness and implement campaigns that enhance talent attraction and market positioning.

  • Performance Management

Leads the global Performance Management framework, including design, implementation, and continuous improvement aligned with business needs and Oracle capabilities. Provides guidance across key annual cycles such as goal setting, performance reviews, calibration, feedback, and development discussions. Supports Regional HR teams and ensures strong integration with Talent Management and Succession Planning processes, while monitoring trends and identifying opportunities for improvement.

  • Employee Engagement & Culture

Drives the global employee engagement strategy, including the planning and rollout of bi-annual surveys across all regions. Partners with HR leaders and Corporate Communications to align survey design, communication, and key messages. Develops and monitors global action plans, tracks engagement results, and supports initiatives to strengthen employee experience and organizational culture.

  • Reporting & KPIs

Defines and manages metrics to evaluate the effectiveness and efficiency of HR processes, using data insights to support decision-making and continuous improvement.

  • Budget & Resource Management

Monitors budget execution and ensures compliance, while managing contracts and relationships with external vendors to optimize resource utilization.


Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Fluent English
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, HR or related field required
  • Relevant business operations and Human Resources experience
  • Experience in deploying Talent Acquisition, Performance Management, Employee Branding, and Engagement processes & policies
  • Strong change agility and proven ability to deal with ambiguity
  • Leadership experience or comparable leadership responsibility
  • Influencing diverse teams in a global organization without formal leadership
  • Strategic orientation and critical thinking skills with the ability to align and integrate HR programs toward a holistic global approach to localization and business applicability
  • Demonstrated success in driving and successfully completing HR projects and process improvements in a global workplace
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and collaborative skills across levels, with an ability to persuade and influence, and the ability to build enthusiasm and commitment
  • Highly flexible, agile, collaborative, and effective at leading and delivering on business imperatives in a dynamic environment
  • Business acumen paired with a hands-on mentality and the ability to match business needs with HR deliverables
  • Analytical and data-driven, with the ability to integrate complex data into insights to create future-focused, high-impact people business strategies
  • Work experience in multiple HR roles and organizations (COE, HRBP, SS)
  • Experience with implementation of HRIS systems and reporting tools
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressured, ambiguous work environment, paying close attention to detail and meeting business-driven deadlines
  • Demonstrated organizational skills and ability to coordinate multiple activities and shift priorities meeting established deadlines
  • Demonstrated ability to break down problems into manageable tasks and processes while challenging assumptions
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with extreme professionalism and discretion

Health Insurance Plans

50% Medication Allowance

Education and foreign language allowance

Mobile Phone Plan

Private Pension Plan

Wellhub

title: Head of Compliance, Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Compliance, Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Head of Compliance & MLRO to oversee the company's compliance and regulatory responsibilities in Brazil. This role will support the business in maintaining a strong compliance culture, managing regulatory relationships, and ensuring alignment with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.


Working closely with local and regional stakeholders, the successful candidate will provide practical compliance guidance while supporting the company's growth and licensing initiatives in Brazil.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated MLRO and lead compliance representative for the Brazil business.
  • Oversee the company's compliance, AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial crime programs.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and provide guidance on relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain relationships with regulators and support regulatory enquiries, reviews, and examinations.
  • Support licensing, registration, and other regulatory initiatives as required.
  • Provide compliance advice to business and operational teams on new products, services, and business activities.
  • Help ensure policies, procedures, and controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory expectations.
  • Oversee key compliance processes, including customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Identify compliance risks and work with stakeholders to implement appropriate controls and solutions.
  • Prepare compliance updates and reporting for management.
  • Deliver compliance training and promote a strong culture of compliance across the organization.
  • Collaborate with regional and global teams on compliance-related matters.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets.
  • Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred.
  • Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous.
  • Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial.
  • Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment.
  • Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.


OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 


Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:


O Grupo Capital:


Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 


Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.


Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:


A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.


Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:


  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:


  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.


Modo de contratação:


  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital


Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Arquiteto de soluções - IA Microsoft
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto de soluções - IA Microsoft em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Arquiteto de soluções - IA & Intelligent Applications


Estamos buscando um(a) profissional com foco em IA aplicada no Azure. Você vai atuar diretamente com clientes, liderando engajamentos técnicos de ponta a ponta: desde o design de arquitetura até a implantação em produção de soluções inteligentes com Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio e ecossistema Microsoft AI. O foco é remover bloqueios técnicos, acelerar adoção e garantir que as soluções de IA saiam do PoC para escala real.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência com Fundamentos de IA e LLMs: Entendimento sólido de como LLMs funcionam, como o tokens, contexto, temperatura, hallucination e grounding. - Experiência prática com prompt engineering: system prompts, few-shot, chain-of-thought e instrução estruturada. -Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura de IA: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), agentes com tool use e orquestração de múltiplos agentes. - Familiaridade com avaliação de qualidade de modelos: métricas como relevância, fundamentação e coerência.
  • Experiência com Azure AI Foundry: Criação de projetos, deploy de modelos e configuração de endpoints. - Uso do model catalog, fine-tuning e avaliação de modelos dentro do Foundry. - Configuração de grounding com Azure AI Search (indexação, chunking, estratégias de retrieval). - Integração com Azure OpenAI Service e outros modelos disponíveis no Foundry.
  • Experiência com Copilot Studio: Experiência com criação de agentes no Copilot Studio na criação de tópicos, entidades, variáveis e fluxo conversacional. - Integração de agentes com fontes de conhecimento externas (SharePoint, sites, documentos). - Configuração de actions e conexão com Power Automate para automações a partir do agente. - Publicação e deployment de agentes em canais (Teams, web, outros)
  • Experiência com Arquitetura e Cloud: Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas orientadas a IA no Azure (AI Foundry + Search + Storage + Function/App Service). - Entendimento de segurança aplicada a IA: managed identity, RBAC, data residency, responsible AI. - Habilidade de comunicar arquiteturas técnicas para públicos técnicos e executivos.


Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions para CI/CD de soluções de IA (MLOps light);
  • Familiaridade com Python para prototipagem rápida, scripts de indexação ou integração com SDKs de IA;
  • Conhecimento de Azure Functions ou Logic Apps para automação serverless;
  • Experiência com Azure API Management (APIM) para expor e governar endpoints de IA;

title: Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 


Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:


O Grupo Capital:


Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 


Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.


Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:


A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.


Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:


  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:


  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.


Modo de contratação:


  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital


Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!
